items.title: Sneaker Gucci kini berlabel 'Made in China' (Indonesian-language coverage)
items.summary: Indonesian lifestyle outlet CNA Indonesia covers Gucci's Drip sneaker, designed by Demna, now carrying a 'Made in China' label for the first time, breaking from the brand's Italian manufacturing tradition. Cites Berenberg analyst warning of 'tension between product origin and Gucci's luxury positioning' and a Milan consultant's blunt line that "Made in China is not a good look." Frames the move alongside recent price cuts as raising consumer doubt about whether Gucci still justifies premium pricing — directly relevant to price-sensitive aspirational buyers in the Indonesian market.

items.title: Gucci official account spotlights Thai ambassadors Billkin and PP Krit from Milan show
items.summary: Japan-based Thai-entertainment outlet (read by the Thai fandom diaspora) reports that Gucci's official channels formally introduced ambassadors Billkin and PP Krit to a global audience following the Milan 'The Store Show' for SS27, pictured alongside Romeo Beckham, Carine Roitfeld and Song Weilong. Framed as a milestone of international recognition for the two Thai stars, feeding into continued SEA fandom engagement into October.

items.title: Thai fan account post celebrating Billkin and PP Krit as Gucci ambassador pair in Milan
items.summary: Thai-language fan post ("เฟรมคู่มาแล้ววววว Billkin PP KRIT BA Gucci ka") celebrating the two Thai Gucci ambassadors appearing together at Milan Fashion Week SS27. Represents organic SEA fandom SNS volume rather than brand-issued content; hashtags associated with this wave (#GUCCISS27xPPKRIT, #GUCCISS27xBILLKIN) were tracked at roughly 460K and 245K mentions respectively by third-party trend coverage, though that count is platform-wide, not SEA-isolated, so treated here as directional only.

items.title: PP Krit Entertainment fan account: 'Next stop Milan' for Gucci SS27 show
items.summary: Fan-run account covering Thai actor PP Krit's departure for Milan as Gucci brand ambassador for the SS27 Store Show. Post recorded approximately 35.4K views and 174 reposts per visible platform counters at time of indexing, among the more concretely measurable SEA-linked SNS engagement found this cycle.

items.title: PurseForum thread on Gucci SS26 'The Tiger' film and Demna's debut collection continues into late September
items.summary: Long-running PurseForum community thread (reaching page 2 of ongoing discussion as of late September, per search-indexed snapshot; direct fetch was blocked by the forum's bot protection so the date is inferred from indexing metadata, not independently confirmed) debates Demna's debut Gucci collection and the SS26 'The Tiger' campaign film, with members weighing in on styling choices, bag construction quality, and whether the aesthetic direction represents genuine reinvention or dilution of house codes. US/global forum base means SEA-specific voice is present but not isolated.

items.title: Reuters wire: Gucci's new 'Made in China' sneaker models break with Italian tradition
items.summary: Reuters wire report, syndicated by CP24 and independently picked up across Asian outlets including Indonesia's cna.id, details Gucci's Drip and slip-on sneakers now labelled 'Made in China,' the first break from all-Italian-made footwear, with Kering sales having 'halved in three years.' Barclays analyst Carole Madjo is quoted warning the shift, combined with recent price cuts, risks confusing shoppers about whether Gucci still justifies premium pricing — a concern with direct bearing on SEA's price-conscious aspirational luxury segment.
